columns.description: INSEE departement code, including 2A and 2B for Corsica and the three-digit overseas codes. This is the join key to french-departement-unemployment.
columns.name: departement_code

columns.description: Official departement name as IGN publishes it.
columns.name: departement_name

columns.description: INSEE code of the region the departement belongs to.
columns.name: region_code

columns.description: GeoJSON geometry type of the boundary, Polygon or MultiPolygon.
columns.name: geometry_type

columns.description: The boundary as a GeoJSON geometry object in EPSG:4326, exactly as IGN published it at Petite Echelle generalisation. Nothing is simplified here.
columns.name: geometry_geojson

columns.description: Westernmost longitude of the boundary, in degrees.
columns.name: bbox_west

columns.description: Southernmost latitude of the boundary, in degrees.
columns.name: bbox_south

columns.description: Easternmost longitude of the boundary, in degrees.
columns.name: bbox_east

columns.description: Northernmost latitude of the boundary, in degrees.
columns.name: bbox_north

indicators.attribution: Source: IGN, ADMIN EXPRESS COG CARTO, edition 2026.
indicators.definition: Administrative boundary of the departement as a GeoJSON geometry object in EPSG:4326, at the provider's Petite Echelle generalisation. It is reference geometry, not a measurement.
indicators.source: IGN, ADMIN EXPRESS COG CARTO Petite Echelle, edition 2026, served by the Geoplateforme WFS

model.description: One row per French departement carrying its administrative boundary as GeoJSON text and its bounding box, keyed by the INSEE departement code so it joins directly to the localised unemployment rates.
model.name: french_departement_geometry

questions.derivation: Select every row and join to french-departement-unemployment on departement_code equals territory_code.
questions.question: What shape is each French departement, so a rate can be drawn on it?

questions.derivation: Read the bounding box columns directly; take their minima and maxima across a set of rows to frame that set.
questions.question: What extent does a map need in order to frame one departement, or all of them?
Which departements belong to the same region?

temporal.meaning: This table has no time dimension. It describes administrative geography for one pinned IGN COG edition, whose reference year is recorded in the source snapshot's represented period. A row is current for the whole of that year.

validations.description: departement_code is unique and every row has one.
validations.name: one-row-per-departement

validations.description: No published column is ever null.
validations.name: required-values

validations.description: Every geometry is a Polygon or a MultiPolygon.
validations.name: geometry-is-a-polygon

validations.description: Each bounding box has west below east and south below north.
validations.name: bounding-box-is-well-formed

validations.description: Every departement carrying a localised unemployment rate appears here, so the choropleth can never render a hole.
validations.name: every-rated-departement-has-a-shape
